items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Erroll Garner wasn't too far away from us... I have something funny to tell you about that... on behalf of Erroll Garner.

ctx.x: And I would always -- after I built up, then I would always get a little gunshy, I'd say, "Wait a minute. I'd better take a rest. Take it easy." You know? But I really missed her. We did a nice thing at the union, in the Local 47, on behalf of Erroll Garner.
Yeah, I remember. I was there. It was beautiful.
